messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT — canary 'promptpath-v2' error rate spike: 9.4% over 5m (threshold 2%). p95 latency 1.8s, traffic 3.2 rps. Suggested mitigation: flip feature flag `promptpath_v2_enabled` -> false. Paging SRE on-call @jess_sre.
alex_prod: paging @jess_sre — seeing 500s from prompt routing for payments and docs tenants. Can confirm recent deploy ID dpl-2025-09-21-78 triggered canary.
jess_sre: ack, I'm on-call and joining. Starting incident bridge now (zoom / bridge link ininc). @support_lead please collect affected tenant list and sample request ids.
support_lead: pulling CS views — initial list: AcmeCorp, Finly, Edify. getting logs and sample request ids, will paste soon.
mike_eng: I can flip the flag from the console. waiting for oncall approval. :hourglass:
jess_sre: please flip now. We'll watch metrics and roll back if no improvement.
mike_eng: running command now:
```bash
# disable experimental promptpath-v2 route
redwood feature-flag set promptpath_v2_enabled false --env prod --actor mike_eng --note "canary error spike 9.4%"
```
incident-bot: FeatureFlagChange recorded: promptpath_v2_enabled=false by mike_eng at 2025-09-21T12:34:10Z (audit id ff-audit-8462).
metrics-bot: post-change (t+90s): error rate dropped to 0.8% (5m), p95 latency down to 650ms. Traffic rebalanced to stable route.
jess_sre: observed recovery on prod metrics, error rate falling. Keeping flag off and holding canary traffic at 0. Will keep bridge open for 30m for monitoring. Thanks @mike_eng.
support_lead: CS notified top-3 tenants with a short status update and ETA for root-cause. They acknowledged; no escalations yet.
alex_prod: creating rollback ticket and tagging release owner: https://tickets/redwood/INC-4123. Deploy dpl-2025-09-21-78 marked for investigation; keeping rollout paused.
eng_lead: schedule RCA/triage tomorrow 10:00am PT. Please collect canary logs, kernel selection traces, and model runtime metrics for that window.
jess_sre: handoff — I'll be online for 30m then passing to @lee_sre for overnight watch. Summary: flipped ff promptpath_v2_enabled=false, immediate mitigation successful, customers notified, monitoring ongoing.
lee_sre: ack handoff, I'll monitor overnight and escalate if any regression. :white_check_mark:
jess_sre: closing bridge in 35m unless we see new alerts. Will open postmortem if we need deeper follow-up.
incident-bot: Incident brief recorded under INC-4123. If anyone adds logs or timelines, please paste to the ticket.
